description: This file contains the implementation of ManufacturerDao interface, providing data access methods for Manufacturer entities, including querying manufacturer data from the database by various criteria such as store, ID, and associated products.

classes.name: ManufacturerDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of data access object for Manufacturer, providing methods to query and manipulate manufacturer data in the database.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Returns the count of products associated with a specific manufacturer.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers associated with a specific merchant store, filtered by language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a manufacturer entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all manufacturers associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByProductsByCategoriesId
methods.description: Returns a list of manufacturers that produce products in specified categories within a store and language.
